items.name: timeline-anim-001
items.title: Вехи с рисующейся линией
items.description: Секция вех: линия между точками рисуется постепенно по мере появления секции, а точки проступают вдоль неё по очереди, синхронно с прогрессом отрисовки.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, ноль зависимостей, палитра в локальных --vibeui-timeline-anim-001-*. Линия рисуется постепенно через transform:scale от 0 до 1 с transform-origin у начала — заготовка линии лежит фоном, поверх неё растёт залитый отрезок. Точки вдоль линии появляются по очереди с задержкой, синхронной с прогрессом отрисовки. В узкой колонке лента вертикальная, container-query на широком контейнере переключает её в горизонтальную; ориентацию можно закрепить пропом orientation.

en.title: Timeline
en.description: A timeline section of milestones and dates.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, palette in local --vibeui-timeline-anim-001-* variables. The line draws progressively via transform:scale from 0 to 1 with transform-origin at the start — a faint track sits as the base and a filled segment grows over it. Dots along the line appear one after another with a delay synced to the drawing progress. The rail is vertical in a narrow column; a container-query flips it to horizontal on a wide container, and the orientation prop can pin it either way.

ai.summary: A timeline section: a heading and a rail of dots with a date and title, connected by a line that draws progressively; dots appear along it one after another. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-timeline-anim-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the progressive line draw via transform:scale with transform-origin at the start
the sequential dot reveal along the line, synced to the drawing progress
the container-query switch from a vertical to a horizontal rail on a wide container
the .dark class rule: without it the component stays light on a dark page in another project
container-type:inline-size on the root — orientation is computed from the section's width, not the window
adapt: the milestone list: date, title and description for each dot
the section title, kicker and description for your own product
the accent color via the accent prop to match your brand
notes: orientation="auto" (default) switches the rail by container width; vertical/horizontal pin it
the line draw progress and dot reveal snap to their end state under prefers-reduced-motion
